premise: At hide and seek in the rock pool Octopus can't be found anywhere, until a grey stone blinks: he has turned the colour of the rocks.
inspiration: The trickster tales of the shape-changer (Anansi, Reynard) made gentle: the disguise is real octopus magic, and the game ends in laughter.
learning: An octopus can change its colour to match what is around it.

en-US.title: Octopus Hide and Seek
en-US.text: {clam:enter} [excited] Hide and seek in the rock pool! {fish:enter} Little Fish was counting. {crab:enter} Crab and {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} {crab:go to rocks} Octopus went to hide. {crab:face happy} Crab hid behind a stone, but his big red claws stuck out. [laughs] Found you, Crab! {crab:wobble} Now, where was Octopus? [short pause] Little Fish looked everywhere. {fish:go to pool another} Under the stones. Behind the boulders. Clam {clam:live peek} opened up to have a look too. {octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s} {fish:face sad} {fish:live look-around} No Octopus anywhere. Then one grey stone… blinked. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] That stone has EYES! The grey turned pinky-orange, {octopus:face happy} and there was Octopus, {octopus:live laugh} laughing. [playfully] I'm an octopus, he said. I can turn the colour of whatever I'm next to! {octopus:live wave} He waved all eight arms. {crab:live clap} Crab clicked his claws. {fish:hearts} [laughs] My turn to hide, said Little Fish. Can you teach me to be a stone?

es-ES.title: El escondite del pulpo
es-ES.text: {clam:enter} [excited] ¡Al escondite en la charca! {fish:enter} Pececito contaba. {crab:enter} Cangrejo y {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} {crab:go to rocks} Pulpo se fueron a esconder. {crab:face happy} Cangrejo se escondió detrás de una piedra, pero sus grandes pinzas rojas asomaban. [laughs] ¡Te pillé, Cangrejo! {crab:wobble} ¿Y dónde estaba Pulpo? [short pause] Pececito buscó por todas partes. {fish:go to pool another} Debajo de las piedras. Detrás de los pedruscos. Almeja {clam:live peek} se abrió para mirar también. {octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s} {fish:face sad} {fish:live look-around} Ni rastro de Pulpo. Entonces, una piedra gris… parpadeó. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Esa piedra tiene OJOS! El gris se volvió naranja rosado, {octopus:face happy} y allí estaba Pulpo, {octopus:live laugh} riéndose. [playfully] Soy un pulpo, dijo. ¡Puedo ponerme del color de lo que tengo al lado! {octopus:live wave} Movió sus ocho brazos. {crab:live clap} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas. {fish:hearts} [laughs] Ahora me escondo yo, dijo Pececito. ¿Me enseñas a ser una piedra?

ja-JP.title: タコくんの かくれんぼ
ja-JP.text: {clam:enter}[excited]潮だまりで、かくれんぼ！{fish:enter}おさかなくんが、かぞえます。{crab:enter}カニくんと{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}{crab:go to rocks}タコくんは、かくれにいきました。{crab:face happy}カニくんは、石のうしろにかくれたけれど、大きな赤いはさみが、にょきっ。[laughs]「カニくん、みーつけた！」 {crab:wobble}さて、タコくんは、どこかな？[short pause]おさかなくんは、あちこちさがしました。{fish:go to pool another}石の下。大きな岩のうしろ。貝さんも{clam:live peek}ぱかっとひらいて、のぞいてみます。{octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s}{fish:face sad}{fish:live look-around}タコくんは、どこにもいません。そのとき、はいいろの石が…ぱちっと、まばたき！{fish:face surprised}[gasps]「あの石、目があるよ！」 はいいろが、ふわっとピンクがかったオレンジいろにかわって、{octopus:face happy}タコくんが、{octopus:live laugh}けらけらわらっていました。[playfully]「ぼく、タコだもん。そばにあるものと、おなじいろになれるんだ！」 {octopus:live wave}八本のうでを、ふりふり。{crab:live clap}カニくんは、はさみをカチカチ。{fish:hearts}[laughs]「こんどは、ぼくがかくれるばん。石になるやりかた、おしえて！」 とおさかなくん。

de-DE.title: Der Krake spielt Verstecken
de-DE.text: {clam:enter} [excited] Verstecken spielen im Tümpel! {fish:enter} Das Fischchen zählte. {crab:enter} Die Krabbe und {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} {crab:go to rocks} der Krake suchten sich ein Versteck. {crab:face happy} Die Krabbe versteckte sich hinter einem Stein, aber ihre großen roten Scheren guckten heraus. [laughs] „Hab dich, Krabbe!“ {crab:wobble} Und wo war der Krake? [short pause] Das Fischchen suchte überall. {fish:go to pool another} Unter den Steinen. Hinter den dicken Brocken. Die Muschel {clam:live peek} ging auf und schaute auch nach. {octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s} {fish:face sad} {fish:live look-around} Kein Krake weit und breit. Doch dann… blinzelte ein grauer Stein. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] „Der Stein hat ja AUGEN!“ Das Grau wurde rosa-orange, {octopus:face happy} und da war der Krake {octopus:live laugh} und lachte. [playfully] „Ich bin ein Krake“, sagte er. „Ich kann die Farbe von allem annehmen, was um mich herum ist!“ {octopus:live wave} Er winkte mit allen acht Armen. {crab:live clap} Die Krabbe klapperte mit den Scheren. {fish:hearts} [laughs] „Jetzt verstecke ich mich“, sagte das Fischchen. „Zeigst du mir, wie man ein Stein wird?“

fr-FR.title: Pieuvre joue à cache-cache
fr-FR.text: {clam:enter} [excited] Cache-cache dans la mare ! {fish:enter} Petit Poisson comptait. {crab:enter} Crabe et {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} {crab:go to rocks} Pieuvre sont partis se cacher. {crab:face happy} Crabe s’est caché derrière un caillou, mais ses grosses pinces rouges dépassaient. [laughs] « Trouvé, Crabe ! » {crab:wobble} Et Pieuvre, où était-elle ? [short pause] Petit Poisson a cherché partout. {fish:go to pool another} Sous les cailloux. Derrière les gros rochers. Palourde {clam:live peek} s’est ouverte pour regarder, elle aussi. {octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s} {fish:face sad} {fish:live look-around} Pas de Pieuvre, nulle part. Puis un caillou gris… a cligné des yeux. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] « Ce caillou a des YEUX ! » Le gris est devenu orange rosé, {octopus:face happy} et voilà Pieuvre, {octopus:live laugh} qui riait aux éclats. [playfully] « Je suis une pieuvre, a-t-elle dit. Je peux prendre la couleur de tout ce qui est à côté de moi ! » {octopus:live wave} Elle a agité ses huit bras. {crab:live clap} Crabe a fait claquer ses pinces. {fish:hearts} [laughs] « À moi de me cacher ! a dit Petit Poisson. Tu m’apprends à faire le caillou ? »

it-IT.title: Nascondino con Polpo
it-IT.text: {clam:enter} [excited] Si gioca a nascondino nella pozza! {fish:enter} Pesciolino contava. {crab:enter} Granchio e {octopus:enter} {octopus:go to pool} {crab:go to rocks} Polpo sono corsi a nascondersi. {crab:face happy} Granchio si è nascosto dietro un sasso, ma le sue grosse chele rosse spuntavano fuori. [laughs] «Tana per Granchio!» {crab:wobble} E Polpo, dov'era finito? [short pause] Pesciolino ha cercato dappertutto. {fish:go to pool another} Sotto i sassi. Dietro i massi. Vongola {clam:live peek} si è aperta per guardare anche lei. {octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s} {fish:face sad} {fish:live look-around} Di Polpo, nemmeno l'ombra. Poi un sasso grigio… ha sbattuto gli occhi. {fish:face surprised} [gasps] Quel sasso ha gli OCCHI! Il grigio si è fatto rosa e arancione, {octopus:face happy} ed ecco Polpo, {octopus:live laugh} che rideva. [playfully] «Sono un polpo», ha detto. «Divento del colore di quello che ho accanto!» {octopus:live wave} Ha agitato tutti e otto i tentacoli. {crab:live clap} Granchio ha fatto clic clac con le chele. {fish:hearts} [laughs] «Adesso mi nascondo io», ha detto Pesciolino. «Mi insegni a diventare un sasso?»

zh-TW.title: 章魚躲貓貓
zh-TW.text: {clam:enter}[excited]潮池裡，玩躲貓貓囉！{fish:enter}小魚負責數數。{crab:enter}螃蟹和{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}{crab:go to rocks}章魚趕快去躲起來。{crab:face happy}螃蟹躲在石頭後面，可是兩隻紅紅的大螯，還露在外面呢。[laughs]「找到你了，螃蟹！」 {crab:wobble}那章魚呢？章魚躲到哪裡去了？[short pause]小魚到處找。{fish:go to pool another}找找石頭底下。看看大石頭後面。蛤蜊也{clam:live peek}打開殼，一起幫忙看。{octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s}{fish:face sad}{fish:live look-around}到處都沒有章魚。這時候，有一顆灰灰的石頭……眨了眨眼睛。{fish:face surprised}[gasps]「那顆石頭有眼睛！」 灰灰的顏色，慢慢變成粉粉的橘色，{octopus:face happy}原來是章魚！{octopus:live laugh}牠哈哈大笑。[playfully]「我是章魚呀，」 牠說，「我靠在什麼東西旁邊，就能變成跟它一樣的顏色！」 {octopus:live wave}牠揮揮八隻腳。{crab:live clap}螃蟹喀喀敲著大螯。{fish:hearts}[laughs]「換我躲了！」 小魚說，「你可以教我變成一顆石頭嗎？」

zh-HK.title: 八爪魚捉迷藏
zh-HK.text: {clam:enter}[excited]石池裏玩捉迷藏啦！{fish:enter}小魚說：「我嚟數！」 {crab:enter}螃蟹和{octopus:enter}{octopus:go to pool}{crab:go to rocks}八爪魚趕快去躲。{crab:face happy}螃蟹躲在一塊石頭後面，可是兩隻紅色的大鉗，都露了出來。[laughs]「捉到你喇，螃蟹！」 {crab:wobble}那麼，八爪魚躲在哪裏呢？[short pause]小魚到處找。{fish:go to pool another}石頭下面，找過了。大石後面，也找過了。蜆{clam:live peek}也張開殼，幫忙看一看。{octopus:tint #9C948C 1 7s}{fish:face sad}{fish:live look-around}八爪魚呢？哪裏都找不到。然後，有一塊灰色的石頭……眨了眨眼。{fish:face surprised}[gasps]「嗰嚿石頭有眼㗎！」 灰色慢慢變成了粉橙色，{octopus:face happy}原來是八爪魚，{octopus:live laugh}正在哈哈大笑呢。[playfully]「我係八爪魚嘛，」 牠說，「我喺咩旁邊，就可以變咩顏色！」 {octopus:live wave}牠揮動八條手臂。{crab:live clap}螃蟹卡嚓卡嚓地拍着大鉗。{fish:hearts}[laughs]「輪到我匿喇！」 小魚說，「你可唔可以教我扮石頭呀？」
